title: Future / Obligatory Participle -andó/-endő in Societal Planning

sections.title: Obligation Participles
sections.content: The future passive participle in -andó/-endő denotes an action that must, ought to, or will be carried out: 'megoldandó feladat' (task to be solved), 'követendő példa' (example to be followed), 'végrehajtandó reformok' (reforms to be executed).

items.spanish: A klímaváltozás a legsürgősebben megoldandó probléma.
items.english: Climate change is the most urgently to-be-solved problem.

items.spanish: A jövő nemzedékek érdekei a legfontosabb figyelembe veendő szempontok.
items.english: The interests of future generations are the most important aspects to be taken into account.

items.spanish: Sok elvégzendő munka vár a kutatókra a megújuló energia terén.
items.english: Much work to be done awaits researchers in renewable energy.
